$comment: Top-level fields: the walking skeleton's first numbers (M1 app-1), printed by tests/e2e/bot-race.spec.ts on the dev machine with no throttling; informational only. `soft` is the perf check's soft-tier baseline (tests/perf/perf.spec.ts fails above 2x it), measured on a CI runner as docs/engineering.md asks. Update it in a PR whose changes note gives the reason.
source: dev machine, headless Chromium from @playwright/test 1.63.0, viewport 915x412 CSS px, device pixel ratio 1, no CPU throttling
scene: bot-race: the skeleton track (3 edges, 2.5 km), 2 box riders, no traffic; checkpoints at tick 60, halfway along the route, and the results screen

soft.source: GitHub Actions ubuntu runner, CI run 36662486374 (PR 52), headless Chromium shell from @playwright/test 1.63.0, SwiftShader, viewport 915x412 @1, 4x CPU throttling from the race start, 20 s of the seed-1 bot race

stepMsRebaselined.reason: The sim gained M2 features (traffic contacts, rider bumps, combat shove, style scoring) since PR 52's 2.1 ms. Ten CI runs of this check from 2026-09-30 (main and lane branches) printed sim step p95 of 2.9, 3.1, 3.2, 3.4, 3.5, 3.8, 3.9, 3.9, 4.2 and 5.1 ms; the median is 3.65 ms, rounded up to the timer's 0.1 ms step. Two of the ten failed the old 4.2 ms limit on runs whose changes did not touch the sim.

softInk.source: GitHub Actions ubuntu runners, the perf job's kodak-look run (tests/perf/perf-looks.spec.ts), same scene and throttling as `soft`
softInk.reason: The ink looks draw the scene offscreen and add a full-screen pass, which SwiftShader pays for in CPU time. Seven CI runs on 2026-10-01 printed kodak frame p95 of 66.6, 116.6, 116.6, 116.7, 116.7, 133.3 and 133.4 ms (p50 33.3 to 50.1 ms). Against classic's 66.6 ms baseline the limit was 133.2 ms, so 2 of the 7 failed, one of them on main. The median p95 is 116.7 ms and the median p50 50 ms. The phone number comes from the maintainer's playtest, not from this tier.
